answer_4.quote: An author annotated all atoms that survived pruning as either invalid or valid (see Table for examples of invalid atoms). Valid δ-SNLI atoms had to (1) be grammatical, (2) entail from H, (3) not entail from P.
answer_4.guideline: Atoms were annotated as valid if they met specific criteria: grammaticality, entailment from the hypothesis, and no entailment from the premise.
